title: 美国国务卿称将开始吊销中国学生签证，包括在关键领域学科学生，影响有多大？在美中国留学生该怎样应对？
body_html:
critical fields:

Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Quantum Computing

Semiconductors and microelectronics

Aerospace engineering and related technologies

Biotechnology and advanced medical research

Telecommunications (especially 5G and next-generation networks)

Robotics

Advanced materials science

Nuclear technology
